purpose: Halo test with INDEPENDENT anchors: pathologist TLS labels define the geometry (distance field), not signature hotspots. Removes the anchor circularity of v4-v7.

v8_2_fallback.trigger: in the v8.1 run 485 of 968 section-readout pairs were dropped as 'sigma unfit': the conditioned residual shows lag-band correlations below 0.05, i.e. the conditioning removed most of the spatial autocorrelation
v8_2_fallback.change: when sigma cannot be fitted the surrogate becomes uncorrelated noise with the same marginal distribution (no smoothing), instead of dropping the test
v8_2_fallback.scope: adds the previously dropped tests only; the 483 tests already computed are unchanged, as are the statistic, the bins and the claim rule
v8_2_fallback.known_limitation: a white surrogate slightly understates the contrast variance when weak autocorrelation remains (rho < 0.05), so the fallback is mildly anti-conservative; the note 'white_fallback' marks every affected row

why_v8_1.probe: label geometry probed before any readout statistic was computed
why_v8_1.finding: per-anchor Voronoi profiles are infeasible with label anchors: only 5-6 of 26 sections reach >=8 evaluable anchors (far-band variants 400-500 / 500-600 / 700-800 / 600+ pooled give 5 / 5 / 6 / 6 sections); label masks carry 16-344 TLS spots per section and form many small components whose Voronoi territories rarely extend to the far bin
why_v8_1.change: primary statistic moved to the SECTION-level edge-distance profile (one profile per section using the whole TLS mask), which is fully powered (hundreds of spots per bin) and corresponds to the Cho 2026 RadialDistance design; the per-anchor version is retained as a descriptive secondary for the 6 sections that qualify
why_v8_1.no_result_seen: at the time of this amendment no readout contrast, p-value or ranking had been computed for any section

anchors.label_quality_flag: USZ LC4 (AUC 0.377) and LC5 (0.18) flagged weak; pre-declared sensitivity drops them

primary_statistic.distance: edge distance from each spot to the nearest TLS-labelled spot; spots within 1.3*pitch of any TLS spot are excluded (the TLS interior)
primary_statistic.bins: 0,100,...,1000 um; a bin enters the contrast only if it holds >=30 spots
primary_statistic.conditioning: own arm identical to v6/v7: readout minus projection on [deciles of the spot's own detection score] + quadratic tissue trend; raw contrast also reported
primary_statistic.section_scope: all tissue spots outside the TLS ring; one contrast per section per readout

null.design: matched-autocorrelation smooth surrogate of the conditioned residual: sigma from lag-band correlations of the residual (bands 100-200/200-400/400-700/700-1000, pairs <=200k), Gaussian kernel truncated at 3 sigma, columns standardised then quantile-mapped to the residual marginal; the SAME TLS distance mask is used, so the null answers 'what contrast does a smooth field with this autocorrelation give around this TLS geometry'

readouts.panel_a: 33 frozen v7 sets (30 GOBP top + B_AXIS + MYC_V1 + RANDOM_32)
readouts.panel_c: 12 single genes (CXCL13, CCL19, CCL21, LTB, CD74, HLA-DRA, IFNG, CXCL9, GZMB, CD8A, MKI67, COL1A1)
readouts.note: with label anchors the readouts are no longer circular by construction; the detection score enters only through conditioning

claim_rule.per_readout: field claimed only if (a) >=50% of evaluable sections have p <= 0.05, (b) >=8 evaluable sections, (c) median observed contrast > median null contrast
claim_rule.controls_expected: RANDOM_32 and MYC_V1 flat; B_AXIS now interpretable as a normal readout
claim_rule.composition_gate: even a positive result stays field-shaped co-variation until the composition control is run (next step of this plan)

secondary.per_anchor_profile: descriptive only, for the sections with >=8 evaluable anchors (6 sections); no null, no claim

pre_declared_sensitivity: sensitivity A: exclude USZ LC4 and LC5
